notes: Burkina Faso parklands (trees_in_farmlands, subtype parkland). Reports tree canopy cover, tree cover and a crop 'trade-off' in kg/ha (crop area lost under canopy x Ministry of Agriculture mean yields; Figure 5, page 10). Yield losses in kg/ha are not a World Bank economic outcome.
